meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以抓取任意网页，并用 Chrome 浏览器引擎将其转换为干净的 Markdown 格式文件。支持自动抓取和等待用户信号两种模式。
howto.when: 当用户要求保存某个网页为 Markdown 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页转成 Markdown：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会抓取该网页并输出 Markdown 文件。

say.text: 抓取 https://example.com 并保存为 output.md
say.note: Claude 会抓取网页并保存到指定文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch any URL and convert it to clean markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports auto-capture on page load or wait-for-user signal for pages requiring login.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage to markdown: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the page and output markdown.

say_en.text: Fetch https://example.com and save as output.md
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and save to specified file.
